round: Style Lab round 7: HyperFrames intro options
dispatch: r7-00 first (alone). When the supervisor has accepted r7-00, start r7-01..r7-05 in parallel. One fonzi-vfx-worker per order.
common_rules: Read the style sheet and style-lab/STYLE.md rule 0 before anything. Use no value that is not in the style sheet.
graphify: fonzi-gym-video-editor/graphify-out/graph.json exists, so run `graphify query "<question>"` before grepping or reading source for any codebase question.
HyperFrames per docs/hyperframes.md: source scripts/hyperframes_setup.sh; allowed commands only; motion code only, no demo media, no remote fonts.
Write ONLY to your order's outputs. Never touch style_fx.py, finish_fx.py, output/final_edit.mp4, other orders' folders, or any input. No commits.
Report in the fonzi-vfx-worker shape: id, status, absolute output paths, style-sheet values used, ffprobe line, frames looked at.
